offer.name: Jasper
offer.description: A marketing platform that combines agents, content workflows and brand context in one workspace.

campaign_context.audience: Hands-on content marketing leads at small and mid-sized teams who already use general AI but still rewrite outputs to fit their brand

underwriting.note: Affiliate economics remain internal and are not evidence for consumer copy.

forbidden_claims: Guaranteed revenue, conversion lift or ranking improvement
A synthetic scene presented as a real customer testimonial
Affiliate payout or commission terms used as consumer-facing proof

sources.source_quote: Jasper connects your marketing team, brand, content, workflows, agents, knowledge, context, and rules in one workspace.
sources.claim: Jasper combines marketing agents, content workflows and brand context in one workspace.

sources.source_quote: Upload examples of your writing and Jasper analyzes tone, style, and key characteristics to develop a personalized brand voice.
sources.claim: Brand Voice is created from writing examples or URLs and can be applied to generated content.

sources.source_quote: The Pro plan offers a free 7-day trial and includes Canvas, core marketing agents, Brand Voices, Knowledge assets and Audiences.
sources.claim: A 7-day Pro trial is available and includes tools for on-brand marketing creation.

sources.source_quote: Different content formats for ads, blogs, or social media made the process faster and more consistent.
sources.claim: A verified reviewer reported faster, more consistent creation across several marketing formats.

sources.source_quote: It speeds up writing and helps maintain a consistent tone, but technical topics can require extra editing.
sources.claim: A verified reviewer reported faster drafting and tone consistency, with extra editing still needed for technical work.

sources.source_quote: It helped cut down outline and drafting time, especially when working with external writers.
sources.claim: A verified reviewer reported less outline and drafting time and the ability to train the product on brand voice.

sources.source_quote: It creates a first draft and keeps brand tone consistent, but parts still need rewriting to sound natural.
sources.claim: A verified marketing reviewer described a useful first-draft workflow with brand consistency and continued human editing.

research_documents.summary: The consumer product is a marketing workspace. Its relevant mechanism is combining brand inputs, audiences and workflows with AI drafting. The requested action is a product trial, not joining its affiliate program.
Independent reviews converge on faster first drafts and better consistency across content formats. They also converge on a credible limitation: human editing and fact checking remain necessary.

deep_brief.objective: Move an experienced content marketer from skepticism about generic AI to starting a 7-day product trial.
deep_brief.audience: A hands-on content lead responsible for producing multiple assets while protecting a recognizable brand voice.
deep_brief.live_problem: The team can produce raw AI text quickly, but the content lead still starts many assets from a blank brief and repeatedly repairs generic, inconsistent drafts.
deep_brief.mechanism: The user supplies brand voice, knowledge and audience context once, then applies that context across agents and content workflows.
deep_brief.supported_result: A faster path to usable first drafts with more consistent brand direction across formats, while preserving human review.
deep_brief.honest_limit: Jasper can still produce generic or repetitive material and does not remove the need for editing or fact checking.
deep_brief.decision_point: Whether a single 7-day trial is worth testing on one real campaign workflow.

conversion_spine.person: A content lead who is the final quality checkpoint for every channel.
conversion_spine.unmet_need: Turn one campaign direction into several recognizable first drafts without rebuilding brand context each time.
conversion_spine.scene_evidence: A representative work session moving between an ad, email and landing-page brief while repeatedly correcting tone.
conversion_spine.consequence_without_offer: The content lead remains the manual rewrite bottleneck.
conversion_spine.causal_solution: Jasper stores and applies brand and audience context across the drafting workflow.
conversion_spine.open_at_cta: The team has not yet tested whether one live campaign can move through the workflow with fewer restarts.
conversion_spine.swap_test: Replacing Jasper with a generic writing tool breaks the specific brand-context and workflow mechanism.

avatar.segment_name: The hands-on content lead who has tried generic AI and still owns the final rewrite

portrait.value: A content marketing lead in a small or mid-sized team who both plans campaigns and edits the final assets.
portrait.source: Independent review roles and product positioning

week_texture.value: Moves among campaign briefs, ads, email, landing pages and review comments, often across the same launch.
week_texture.source: Product workflows and multi-format review use cases

identity_gap.value: Wants to be the person shaping the campaign, but keeps becoming the person who repairs every first draft.
identity_gap.source: Review convergence on speed, consistency and continued editing

surface_fear.value: The next AI draft will sound generic and create another editing pass.

deep_fear.value: Scaling output will dilute the brand and make the team harder to trust.
deep_fear.source: Brand Voice positioning and reviewer concerns

wordless_fear.value: If every draft still depends on their rewrite, they are not leading a system; they are the system.
wordless_fear.source: Derived from the manual bottleneck described across reviews

shame_and_hiding.value: Avoids admitting how much supposedly automated copy is still rebuilt by hand.
shame_and_hiding.source: Derived from reported generic output and extra editing

near_dream.value: Open a useful first draft instead of another blank document.

deep_dream.value: Let teammates create without losing the brand voice at every handoff.

identity_dream.value: Become the campaign editor and strategist, not the permanent rewrite bottleneck.
identity_dream.source: Derived from audience role and supported workflow outcome

envy_comparison.value: Notices teams that publish across channels without every asset waiting on one senior editor.

cause_theory.value: General AI lacks enough persistent brand, audience and workflow context.
cause_theory.source: Official product mechanism and independent limitations

who_is_blamed.value: The tools for producing generic text and the team for treating prompts as a process.

solution_beliefs.value: A useful system must carry brand rules and campaign context across formats, not just write faster.
solution_beliefs.source: Official Brand Voice and platform documentation

past_attempts_scars.value: Has already tried general AI and learned that fast output can create slow editing.
past_attempts_scars.source: Independent reviews mentioning generic, repetitive output and extra editing

awareness_sophistication.entry_point_note: Do not sell AI writing. Sell a controlled campaign workflow that acknowledges editing still exists.

already_seen.value: Claims that AI writes content faster, beats the blank page and sounds exactly like the brand.

consumer_trust_wounds.value: Promises of human-sounding, factually accurate copy that still arrives generic or needs correction.

stated_vs_real_objection.real: I do not want to pay for another interface that gives me the same generic draft.

purchase_context.value: Most credible when tested on one current campaign rather than evaluated through a generic demo prompt.

internal_price_anchor.value: Compares the subscription with the recurring cost of senior editing time, while remaining sensitive to price.
internal_price_anchor.source: Capterra price objections and time-saving reviews

permission_needed.value: Permission to test the workflow without pretending the tool replaces judgment or editing.
permission_needed.source: Review convergence on value plus limitations

decision_moment.value: Chooses one real campaign and decides whether to run it through the 7-day trial.

voc_lines.line: Sometimes the content needs manual editing to sound more natural.
It helped cut down on outline and drafting time.
You still need to tweak and rewrite parts to make it more natural.

the_one_trigger.value: Seeing the same campaign brief produce several channel drafts while retaining one defined voice.

transformation_arc.value: From manually rescuing isolated AI drafts to directing a context-aware content workflow.
transformation_arc.source: Official platform mechanism and independent outcomes

forbidden_word.source: Contradicted by the documented need for setup, editing and fact checking

summary.core_identity: A hands-on content lead who protects the brand while carrying too much of the final drafting burden.
current_state: Uses or has tested general AI
Still repairs generic or inconsistent drafts
summary.central_problem_in_their_words: Fast output is not useful if I still have to rebuild the voice and context every time.
summary.desired_result: A faster first-draft workflow that carries brand and audience context across campaign assets.
summary.product_meaning: Not another writer, but a testable system for reducing context resets while the marketer keeps final judgment.

declared_gaps: No permission to claim editing disappears

test_kit.primary_hypothesis: A context-reset bottleneck is more credible and differentiated than a generic speed promise.

candidate_routes.hypothesis: Show how Brand Voice, Audiences and Knowledge change the first-draft workflow.
Name the expensive pattern: fast AI output followed by slow senior rewriting.
Use a clearly representative work scene, not a customer testimonial or invented result.

test_kit.required_honesty: Acknowledge that human editing and fact checking remain part of the workflow.
test_kit.cta: Start a 7-day Pro trial with one real campaign.

creative_hint: Avoid any hook comparing a list of AI tools or claiming that every tool sounds the same. Begin inside the audience's real rewrite bottleneck.
